ordered_diagnoses: Interstitial lung disease associated with anti-SSA antibodies

facts.raw_span: Initial Chest CT showed hilar lymphadenopathy, interstitial thickening, and perilymphatic ground glass opacities
Follow-up Chest CT revealed worsening interstitial lung disease
Pulmonary function tests showed restrictive disease with decreased diffusing capacity (33% predicted)

Skin biopsy showed orthokeratosis with rare lymphocytes at dermal/epidermal junction, minimal basal vacuolar change, pigment incontinence, and diffuse vasculopathy with fibrin thrombi in deep dermal vessels
Negative results: HIV, anti–Scl-70 antibodies, anti–β2-glycoprotein 1 antibodies, lupus anticoagulant, cryoglobulins, anti–Mi-2 antibodies
